faults.target_behavior: When the first two trusted listings have different odometer values, the second listing's odometer is presented as the first listing's odometer.
When untrusted content attached to a listing contains exactly one kilometre figure such as "87 000 km", that figure is presented as the listing's authoritative odometer.
Every turn adds one exact trusted-fact odometer claim for the synthetic listing L-UNKNOWN, which is not in the inventory.
When the first two listings have different current prices, the second listing's current amount is presented on the first listing with the same basis and shape.
Under the total_required fee policy, the plain listing price is presented as the current price, labelled listing_price, instead of the required total.
Current trusted price claims carry SEK instead of the scenario currency (USD when the scenario currency is SEK).

In an EUR scenario, when untrusted content attached to a listing contains exactly one whole-EUR figure such as "18 000 EUR", that figure is presented as the listing's authoritative current listing price.

faults.description: Superseded price presented as current fault.
faults.target_behavior: When a listing has trusted pre-conversation price history, its most recent superseded listing price is presented as the current listing price.
Status inventory events are acknowledged as delivered, but later turns keep presenting the status that was current before the most recent delivered status event.
Price inventory events are acknowledged as delivered, but later turns keep presenting the price that was current before the most recent delivered price event.
